items.overview: The five bachelors named Kabila, Arefin, Shuvo, Nehal and Habu coming from different states had absolutely no idea that staying together under a roof will change their life.

episodes.title: Episode 41, Episode 42, Episode 43, Episode 44, Episode 45, Episode 46, Episode 47, Episode 33
episodes.overview:
After chasing the maid with a knife, Pagla Sujon gets caught by everyone. Meanwhile, Motlob’s money mix-up creates chaos, and the maid threatens to bomb the bachelor house!

The bachelors hold a court over Pagla Sujon and the maid’s chaos, while Motlob’s X-ray drama and Pasha Bhai’s new plan add to the laughter and madness!

Hearing Kabila’s uncle is a RAB officer, Pagla Sujon runs away in fear! Meanwhile, chaos returns to the bachelor house with Bua, Jakir, and Motlob’s funny mischiefs.

After a long time, Bachchu Bhai returns and talks about investing in the underworld, shocking everyone! Later, at Kaka-Kaki’s house, he looks for a place to keep his money—while Bua tries to take her chance.

Motlob takes money from Bachchu Bhai for his wife’s treatment, while chaos erupts as Bua is accused of stealing. Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai chills on the street with his gang, and Pasha Bhai tries to help Nehal with some cash.

While delivering boxers, Pasha Bhai tries to treat Kabila to soup, and back home, Bua secretly eats the chicken leg! Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai enjoys a resort hangout, joined by the bachelors for a lavish lunch.

The bachelors enjoy swimming and dinner with Bachchu Bhai at the resort, but the fun turns to chaos at night when thieves break in, knock everyone out with spray, and steal everything!

The bachelors interrogate Motlob over the theft, while Jakir enjoys a fun day out with Lamia. But just then, a beautiful girl walks into the bachelor flat—leaving Pasha Bhai completely stunned!

episodes.title: Episode 49, Episode 50, Episode 51, Episode 52, Episode 53, Episode 54, Episode 55, Episode 56
episodes.overview:
While searching for Zayef, his aunt visits the bachelor house. There, she meets Pasha Bhai and Kabila, who try to help her. Pasha Bhai even brings her a cup of coffee himself, making her feel welcomed.

After Pasha Bhai meets Sporsho, his behavior starts to change, and Kabila and Nehal tease him about it at the bachelor house. Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai is seen chatting with an unfamiliar girl at his own home!

After the burglary at the bachelor house, Shuvo video-calls Kabila and Nehal to check in and asks them to send a new phone for Kabila. Meanwhile, Habu asks the maid to cook hilsa fish — but Miss Lovely ends up eating it all.

After the burglary, Nehal brings an iPhone from America for Kabila, who shows it to Pasha Bhai to make him jealous. Nehal also secretly gives Habu 20,000 taka to buy a phone.

Sporsho sits in Pasha Bhai’s room, chatting with him, while Kabila, Nehal, Habu, and Zakir try to figure out what’s happening from outside. Later, at the zoo, the bachelors unexpectedly run into Sporsho and Zayef.

As the bachelors prepare to leave the zoo, they meet Sparsho and Zaif. Kabira, Pasha, Habu, and Zakir persuade Nehal to explore the zoo again, while Tiger Zakir asks him for a photo with the tiger.

After the zoo visit, Habu Bhai treats everyone. Malu Dalal reveals the MD of LogeAchi.com’s personal issue, which soon makes headlines about Bacchu Sir’s private matter.

Miss Lovely visits Nehal to learn English before going to America. After seeing Bacchu Sir’s personal news in the paper, Zakir and the bachelors visit him at his home.

episodes.title: Episode 57, Episode 58, Episode 59, Episode 60, Episode 61, Episode 62, Episode 63, Episode 64
episodes.overview:
Kabila questions Bachchu Bhai about hiring Antora, while Habu asks Nehal to look for a suitable bride for him. Meanwhile, Nehal gifts Pasha Bhai a laptop—leaving Kabila asking Nehal why he bought it.

Sporsho sends an apology cake to the bachelors, which Pasha, Zakir, and Habu quickly finish. Later, Pasha Bhai asks Kabila to suggest Bachchu Bhai invest in the underworld, while Bachchu confirms Antora’s job.

At night, Kabila catches Zakir, Habu, and Pasha Bhai for eating the cake and scolds everyone. Meanwhile, Nehal teaches Lovely Buya English, discusses Antora’s job with Shuvo alongside Kabila, and Rokia’s cousin Rocky visits the house.

Kabila introduces Rocky to everyone at the house. Later, Zakir makes fun of Rocky, which leads Rocky to complain to Kabila.

Zakir and Habu plan not to let Rocky sleep in the room, while Rocky enters Pasha Bhai’s room without permission. Meanwhile, Bachchu Bhai offers Habu a job worth 100,000 taka, and after Pasha misbehaves with Rocky, Rocky seeks justice from Kabila.

Pasha Bhai welcomes Zayef into his room and offers him juice, while Zakir teases Rocky. Meanwhile, Pasha shows Nehal the design of an underworld boxer, Shirin Khala talks to Sporsho about her brother Tarek’s behavior, and Lovely Buya gets caught by Pasha while sneaking powdered milk.

Rocky complains to Kabila that Zakir keeps teasing him, while Habu talks to Pasha Bhai and Zakir about possible job offers. Meanwhile, Nehal and Kabila approach Bachchu Bhai for a job, and Rocky gets caught eating Pasha Bhai’s dates and nuts.

Zakir treats everyone in the house with sweets, claiming it’s for his passport. Meanwhile, Habu tries to convince Bachchu Bhai to get Nehal and Kabila to join the job, Rocky wants to sleep in Pasha Bhai’s room at night, and Motlub returns 100 taka to Nehal, while Habu scolds everyone at the dining table for hesitating to join the job.

episodes.title: Episode 65, Episode 66, Episode 67, Episode 68, Episode 69, Episode 70, Episode 71, Episode 72
episodes.overview:
Everyone at LogeAchi.com is worried about the job Habu has landed. Upset by everyone’s comments, Habu behaves rudely, and through his aunt, Kabila asks him not to take the job.

With Rokeya’s cousin Rocky staying at the house, everyone gets annoyed by his constant antics. Meanwhile, Zakir tries to befriend Sporsho by keeping Zayef happy.

Pasha sends Motlub out to deliver boxers but doesn’t give him rickshaw fare, and Motlub later claims he lost the money while walking back. Meanwhile, Habu meets Bachchu and gets his job confirmed.

Habu’s appointment letter arrives at the house, bringing mixed reactions from everyone. Meanwhile, Pasha Bhai spends the entire day at Bachchu’s farmhouse, pushing for an underworld investment.

After learning from Nehal, Zakir starts dressing up smartly all the time. Meanwhile, Lovely Khala cooks payesh to congratulate Habu on his new job, and on the way back from the market, Habu and the uncle run into Shuvo’s friend Masta.

Everyone gets annoyed when Masta suddenly shows up at the house, and the bachelors discuss whether they should let him stay. When Nehal informs Shuvo, he says he had no idea Masta would come to the house.

Rocky keeps annoying everyone at the bachelor house. To lighten the mood, the uncle suggests taking all the bachelors out for a trip.

Sporsho has been dealing with personal problems for a few days and starts behaving rudely with everyone. Nehal learns about her situation and tries to help resolve the issue.
